[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Elin Garza]] commanded a '''platoon''' in the [[45th Infantry Division]] of the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] during the [[Great Galactic War]], and the unit fought a ten-month [[Battle of Bomodon|guerrilla war]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Bomodon]].
